agents.participant: One AI participant per original participant; each session is an independent sequence of screens, received through the injected llm(prompt) call.

roles.note: Experiment 1 and 3 alternate butcher/baker; Experiment 2 uses the baker text for all (iss_e2_roles).

roles.justification: The paper's own experimenter/interface role: presents printed screens and performs offline pairing and payment after data collection (ev1_end).

visibility: Each participant sees only their own condition's private/public boxes; the partner's decision is never shown (decisions were independent; pairing was offline). Later screens include earlier screens in the transcript.
arms: adapter.all_arms() lists 16 + 16 + 8 = 40 arms; run_sessions(llm, seed, n, arms=None) runs n participants per arm.

functions.build_prompt: build_prompt(study, condition, role) -> first screen sequence ending in the decision request

replayAdaptations: Butcher-perspective text is a mechanical Butcher/Baker swap (iss_e1_butcher).
Experiment 2 runs every participant with the baker-perspective text (iss_e2_roles).
The common-knowledge placeholders are both filled with the together-payoff (iss_e1_ckvals).
The silent loudspeaker and the payoff reveal wording are implementation wording (iss_e1_silent, iss_e1_price).
Demographics are not administered (items not printed, iss_e1_demo).
Experiment 3 Big Five is not administered (iss_e3_big5).
